offers.line: I'll give you exactly what you asked. Ten percent. Plus a dollar a unit until I've got half a million back, then a quarter forever. You keep control, I keep getting paid.

conditions: TV and retail launch within 90 days
offers.line: Two hundred fifty thousand for twenty-five percent. I'll have you on live TV in ninety days and in stores by spring.
Two-fifty for thirty percent, and I'll walk you into every chain I know.

negotiation.text: Maya, a quarter forever is a curse on your margin. Don't do the royalty.
Lena, you're the shark I wanted. Would you do $250,000 for 15%?
I hear you. I'll come down to 22 percent, and that includes the TV launch. That's my best.

conditions: TV and retail launch within 90 days

negotiation.text: Eighteen and I'll shake your hand right now.
Twenty-two is fair for what I bring, Maya. I'm going to hold. I wish you so much luck.
Thank you, all of you. I'd rather own the hero than sell it cheap. I'm going to get that patent and come back.
